text: Toronto Community Housing Corporation owns and maintains 12 affordable housing facilities in Ward 11, 8 operated by Toronto Community Housing Corporation, and 4 operated by Toronto Seniors Housing Corporation. Seven of them require upgrades to improve security, landscaping and energy management.
